description: Dust Accounts (Batch). Calls only POST /v4/wallets/batch/dust-accounts. The request body lists wallets to read. This tool does not create, modify, or delete data. Solana API endpoint for fetching Token-2022 and SPL dust accounts across multiple wallets. Returns reclaimable tokens for up to 10 wallets, max 1000 accounts.

body.description: Request payload model for dust accounts many params parameters used by this API endpoint.

limit.description: Maximum number of dust accounts to return across all wallets. Defaults to 1000.

ownerAddresses.description: List of Solana wallet addresses to query (1-10 wallets).

page.description: Page number to return (zero-indexed). Defaults to 0.

sortByAsc.description: Sort ascending by 'tokenAccountAddress', 'mintAddress', 'name', 'symbol', 'balance', 'valueUsd', or 'rentUsd'. If omitted, no sorting is applied. Only one of `sortByAsc` or `sortByDesc` can be used.

sortByDesc.description: Sort descending by 'tokenAccountAddress', 'mintAddress', 'name', 'symbol', 'balance', 'valueUsd', or 'rentUsd'. If omitted, no sorting is applied. Only one of `sortByAsc` or `sortByDesc` can be used.

name: get-dust-accounts-batch
title: Dust Accounts (Batch)
